name: codex-cost-orchestrator
description: Implicit cost-aware Codex routing with selectable workers, schema-checked inputs, generation fencing, contract-closed evidence, and exact-state acceptance.

interface.shortDescription: Cost-aware routing with selectable workers and exact-state acceptance.
interface.longDescription: Codex Cost Orchestrator implicitly classifies implementation work, verifies atomic low-risk edits directly in Sol, routes schema-checked closed contracts through availability-aware user-selectable model and effort policies, preflights native dispatch, fences stale worker results, preserves the original baseline, and gates exact-state completion through primary Sol evidence or a structurally required independent review epoch.
defaultPrompt: Implement and verify this feature using the default cost-aware route.
Classify this change, then use the least costly adequate execution lane.
Review this accumulated change set with a fresh review epoch.
